title: Navigation between wilderness rooms uses relative compass directions ('one north and two east of X') that don't always match actual movement outcomes 1:1 — occasionally moving a stated direction landed in a room whose own position description didn't line up with the prior room's stated bearings, requiring repeated 'get your bearings' calls to re-orient.
